---
name: Bug report
about: A skill routed wrongly, gave bad instructions, or contradicted the OpenClips server
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Skill and version**
Which skill, and the version from `VERSION`.

**Host**
Claude Code, claude.ai, Cowork, Codex, Cursor, other.

**What you asked**
The message you sent, as close to verbatim as you can share. Remove anything private.

**What happened**
What the agent did, and what it should have done instead.

**Did it spend credits it should not have?**
Yes or no. If yes, say roughly how many and which tool.
